relationships.subject: obesity
relationships.evidence_quote: obesity contributes to the development of age-related chronic diseases by promoting cellular senescence through oxidative stress, inflammatory responses, and metabolic disturbances

relationships.subject: adipokines
relationships.evidence_quote: Adipokines activate the NF-κB signaling pathway and cooperate with the SASP to induce epigenetic reprogramming of chondrocytes

relationships.subject: DNA methylation
relationships.evidence_quote: in OA cartilage, various matrix-degrading enzymes, including MMP-3, MMP-9, and ADAMTS-4, are markedly elevated and are associated with promoter demethylation events

key_findings: Review frames an obesity-aging-OA axis linked by chronic inflammation, senescence/SASP and epigenetic reprogramming of chondrocytes
Promoter demethylation is associated with elevated MMP-3, MMP-9 and ADAMTS-4 in OA cartilage
